summary: Frontend-only verification of the .btn-luxe-outline white-box CSS bug in the profile details modal. Logged in with test user, opened profile modal via button[aria-label='Profile menu'] on /dashboard, inspected computed styles of profile-close-button and profile-copy-email-button, verified functionality (close + copy) and took desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) screenshots. All 5 requested checks PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: globals.css is ~2865 lines with a late 'final override' block duplicating .btn-luxe-outline rules (also defined ~line 735 inside @layer components, whose :hover still uses a white inset oklch(1 0 240 / 0.12)). The override currently wins, but consolidating the two definitions would prevent regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow works: /login -> data-testid auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button -> redirect to /dashboard within ~10s. Profile modal: click button[aria-label='Profile menu']; testids profile-close-button, profile-copy-email-button. Verified computed styles: background-image linear-gradient(lab(9.53...) -> lab(4.44...)) i.e. dark, background-color rgba(0,0,0,0), box-shadow insets are lab(1.98...) / lab(0.90...) / lab(0 0 0/0.85) with NO rgba(255,255,255) or light inset. Close click removes modal (element count 0); copy click swaps icon to check (lime #CCFF00). Mobile 390x844 identical dark styles; screenshots show no white box around X. Only console noise: Next.js font preload warnings.
rca_of_the_issue: Original white box came from a white inset highlight in .btn-luxe-outline box-shadow plus a light background gradient; the final override block in /app/app/globals.css (lines ~2829-2855) removes the white inset and uses a dark oklch(0.22)->oklch(0.17) gradient. Verified fixed via computed styles and screenshots.
